name: Crane
description: A crane lifts a box you need out of the grid and sets it down in its own cell — nothing is created, a box is only moved.
howToPlay: Tap a crane to make it fetch a box. It reads the top two rows of customers, works out which colour is wanted most, and lifts a box of that colour from somewhere else in the grid, leaving that cell empty. The marble on its hook shows the colour it would fetch right now, and it changes as customers get served — so you can play a crane early to open a path or crack the ice next to it, or hold out for a better-matching colour. Cranes follow the normal rule: they need a clear path to the bottom of the grid. Iced boxes are frozen in place and cannot be lifted.
